title: The King of Fighters '98
note: Name of the character currently fighting next to P1, P2 or CPU (team read from RAM, FBNeo cheat codes).

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

health.note: health bar in %, full = 103 (cheat database); a K.O. takes its 16-bit word below zero, its high byte at 0xFF (RetroAchievements code notes, lose = ff), which read as a full bar and hid every K.O. (Seb, 1.31): from 0x80 it reads empty

health_p2.note: health bar in %, full = 103 (cheat database); a K.O. takes its 16-bit word below zero, its high byte at 0xFF (RetroAchievements code notes, lose = ff), which read as a full bar and hid every K.O. (Seb, 1.31): from 0x80 it reads empty

_time_sub.note: the timer's fraction of a second (RetroAchievements code notes, 0xa83a Timer: Millseconds), it moves at every frame once the round's timer runs, FIGHT ! waits for it to come with the game's own FIGHT or GO (1.31.1)

score.note: player 1 score, found with learn.bat (RetroArch, FinalBurn Neo)

score_p2.note: player 2 score, found with learn.bat (RetroArch, FinalBurn Neo)

beat.note: VS match, player 1 win streak (BEAT BY at the top of the screen), to find with learn.bat (beat=...)

beat_p2.note: VS match, player 2 win streak (BEAT BY at the top of the screen), to find with learn.bat (beat2=...)

round.note: round of the match, from 0, one more at each K.O. (cheat database "Select Current Round", 1 to 6; it was read as the match number and shown as STAGE n, but Seb saw it move at each K.O. in 1.31), shown as ROUND n when the next fight begins

backdrop.note: backdrop of the fight (cheat database "Select Backdrop"): 0 Japan (Street), 1 China, 2 Korea, 3 Mid-East, 4 Spain, 5 USA (Yard), 6 Japan (Temple), 7 USA (Wharf), 8 Blacknoah. Picks the HD theme in "hd": "stages"

_screen.note: the screen the game shows (RetroAchievements code notes, 0x8502 Screen ID (16bits), 77b2 = Character selection screen, b3a0 = Order select, e8be = Fighting); its select screens give VS and no event of a fight (1.31.1, K.O. audit), to confirm in game

hd.note: HD screen theme for each backdrop value (index = value), and the place shown under ROUND 1 (the backdrops of the cheat database), see README, HD themes
